# ACCORD LAB • Due diligence engagement + five review streams
# EDIT HERE: edit these Python values, then press Run Python.
buyer = "Northstar Ventures"
target = "Atlas Software Ltd"
transaction_value = 12000000
review_days = 20

# Lesson: a list of dictionaries defines the document categories.
# EDIT HERE: change a reviewer or add a sixth category.
categories = [
    {"name": "Corporate & ownership", "reviewer": "Corporate counsel", "documents": 3},
    {"name": "Commercial contracts", "reviewer": "Commercial counsel", "documents": 3},
    {"name": "People & employment", "reviewer": "Employment counsel", "documents": 3},
    {"name": "IP, technology & privacy", "reviewer": "IP / privacy counsel", "documents": 3},
    {"name": "Disputes & compliance", "reviewer": "Regulatory counsel", "documents": 3},
]
variables = {"buyer": buyer, "target": target,
             "transaction_value": transaction_value,
             "review_days": review_days,
             "category_count": len(categories)}

# A loop turns the same categories into a document schedule.
review_schedule = "\n".join(
    f"{i}. {category['name']} — {category['documents']} documents; "
    f"reviewer: {category['reviewer']}"
    for i, category in enumerate(categories, start=1)
)
agreement = f"""LEGAL DUE DILIGENCE — ENGAGEMENT DRAFT
Client: {buyer}
Target: {target}
Indicative transaction value: USD {transaction_value:,.0f}
Review period: {review_days} business days

1. Appointment and scope
The client appoints the review team to assess the documents made
available for the proposed acquisition of {target}.

2. Document review schedule
{review_schedule}

3. Review standards
Reviewers shall link each material issue to its source, describe
its potential impact and propose a question or remediation action.

4. Coordination and escalation
Stream owners shall escalate missing information and material
issues promptly. The lead counsel consolidates all stream reports.

5. Deliverables and reliance
The final pack includes an evidence index, risk register, open
questions and recommended conditions. No investment decision is
automatically made by this workflow.

6. Confidentiality and limitations
Documents are for the instructed matter only. Missing or incomplete
source material must be identified. This is a fictional learning
example and does not replace professional review.
"""

# A loop creates a parallel workflow node for each category.
workflow = [{"id": "intake", "title": "Open & index data room",
             "owner": "Transaction lead", "after": []}]
review_ids = []
for i, category in enumerate(categories):
    node_id = f"review_{i}"
    review_ids.append(node_id)
    workflow.append({"id": node_id, "title": category["name"],
                     "owner": category["reviewer"], "after": ["intake"]})

# The consolidation gate waits for every category.
workflow += [
    {"id": "consolidate", "title": "Consolidate risk register",
     "owner": "Lead counsel", "after": review_ids},
    {"id": "approve", "title": "Approve committee pack",
     "owner": "Transaction lead", "after": ["consolidate"]},
]
print(f"Created {len(categories)} parallel review streams for {target}.")
